jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Consultant
jobs_results.description:
Visualitics help companies become data-driven organizations. We transform clients into results-oriented organizations and we help them focus more on understanding their business, and less on the process of data collection and analysis. We don’t just provide clients with a strategy. We train analysts and data experts and create sustainable and repeatable processes to make data visualization a reality for everyone. We don’t just provide clients with a strategy to follow: we study and value the information they have step by step, together.

We are looking for a new member of our hyper-growing teams based in Madrid (ES) and Turin (IT).

As a BI Consultant, you use your data and visualization skills and business mindset to analyze the functional and technical needs, design, test, optimize and deploy.

You participate in interesting projects and you make a difference every day.

You will work with the business in understanding their evolving requirements and with IT to deliver practical but... innovative solutions of real business benefit.

You are a self-starter with a good knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) tools and approaches. You also have the personal skills, creativity and drive to build your own prototype solutions and to provide training and guidance to team members and partners.

Tasks

What You Will Be Doing:

Design and create data visualizations (reports and dashboards) as required to support business needs
• Define, design and develop complex/nested SQL queries or extracts for dashboards.
• Establish standards and best practices for dashboards and related technologies for the project
• Manage dashboard repository and optimize content
• Develop regular and ad-hoc analysis methods and reports
• Deploy Business Intelligence solutions
• Successfully complete all assigned custom production jobs on time and according to project requirements
• Ensure both internal and external customer satisfaction, with a successful product delivery
• Demonstrate your skill and aptitude regarding custom product team processes (i.e. merge/purge, geo spatial, file conversion, file clean up, template creation, data appends, suppressions, key coding, data/file manipulation, etc.)
• Demonstrate technical proficiency in various vendor applications
• Train customer and team members

Requirements

Qualifications & Competences:

1 to 5 years of experience in BI sector
• Degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science or equivalent work experience
• Ability to master new tools quickly
• Demonstrates a high level of organization and strong attention to detail
• Ability to work independently and proactively
• Solves problems by gathering information, evaluating options and recommending solutions
• Effective communication skills, both verbal and written
• Strong passion for data and technology
• Able to work under pressure and in complex organizations
• Excellent Spanish is required
• Good English is a must

Technology Skillset:

2+ years' experience with any Analytics and Data Visualization tools (Tableau, Power Bi, Qlikview)
• 1+ years' experience Previous experience with any ETL tool (Tableau Prep, Knime, SSIS, Talend, Pentaho, Business Objects, Alteryx, Power Query, DAX/M)
• SQL knowledge and experience working with databases and programming languages is preferred
• Programming languages like Python, R, Javascript, etc. is preferred
• System Engineering knowledge is a plus

Benefits

What do we offer:

Competitive salary
• Bonus on target achievement
• Friendly and challenging working environment
• Professional development and Continuous Training Program

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Data Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola Data Lover! 💙

En SDG, no solo tendrás la oportunidad de formar parte de algo increíble, ¡sino que vivirás lo que significa ser un auténtico especialista en Data & Analytics!

¿Estás preparadx para embarcarte en esta emocionante aventura? con nosotrxs, podrás potenciar todas tus habilidades y capacidades analíticas, tecnológicas y de negocio.

¡Es hora de despegar hacia el futuro mediante el poder de los datos! Únete a nosotros y prepárate para romper las reglas y alcanzar tu mejor versión 🚀✨.

Descubre el poder de SDG: líderes globales en la industria del dato 💥📊

En SDG trabajamos para la mitad de las empresas del IBEX-35, pero también en multitud de compañías internacionales. Gracias al boom de la analítica, estamos en un ritmo constante de crecimiento, y desde 1994 nos hemos convertido en el socio de confianza para empresas que desean maximizar todo el potencial de sus datos.

Si buscas formar parte de una compañía 100% especializada en #Data & #Analytics, ¡te estamos... esperando!

¿Qué te hará triunfar en está posición? 👇
• Contar de 2 a 5 años de experiencia trabajando con herramientas de visualización, ETL (modelado del dato) y BBDD SQL ya que son la base de todos los proyectos en los que estarás involucrado.
• Experiencia en lo que se refiere al desarrollo de cuadros de mando.
• Se requiere inglés alto ya que trabajarás en equipos globales.
• Estudios en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de datos, Industriales, o contar con un Ciclo Superior u otra salida académica que te haya dotado de capacidad de desarrollo y pensamiento crítico en este ambiente.

¿Cuál será tu misión? ✍
• Formarás parte del crecimiento de la compañía liderando proyectos de analítica.
• Serás un referente técnico para todos tus colaboradores.

¿Qué nos hace diferentes? 🧐

En nuestros proyectos, los datos y la tecnología son los protagonistas, te formaremos para que puedas trabajar con lo último del mercado (tenemos un área de innovación dónde impulsamos nuevos partnerships con fabricantes tecnológicos y centros de I+D).

Tendrás todas las oportunidades para alcanzar tu mejor versión, con un plan de carrera totalmente personalizado en el que aprenderás por ti mismo y además, contarás con el apoyo del resto de compañerxs.

Tu mismo te marcarás tus propios tiempos, semestralmente hablarás con tu responsable para compartir feedback y nuevos retos, y en base a tus resultados, habrá una revisión salarial.

Somos una gran familia, desde el minuto 1 trataremos de hacerte la vida más fácil. Tanto tus compañerxs como el resto de equipo siempre tendrán una sonrisa y estarán dispuestos a ayudarte y ofrecerte todo su apoyo.

Colaborarás y trabajarás en tu día a día con grandes referentes (técnicos y/o de negocio), estarán encantados de enseñarte todo lo posible y se sentirán orgullosxs de verte crecer.

Con nosotros el Smartwork es posible. Vivirás una forma de trabajo en la que cada uno gestiona su propio tiempo.

Somos una marca con propósito. Creemos que la diversidad y la inclusión ayudan a promover una cultura de creatividad, permitiéndonos superar nuevas situaciones y desafíos.

Metiéndonos un poco más en temas más formales, pero no menos importantes, ofrecemos contrato indefinido, ¡queremos que te quedes con nosotrxs mucho tiempo!, salario competitivo de acuerdo con tú nivel de formación y experiencia (no te preocupes, ya qué, en la primera entrevista, trataremos este aspecto y te informaremos si tus expectativas están alineadas) y te ofrecemos una ayuda económica para gastos ocasionados por el teletrabajo.

Podríamos continuar detallando que nos hace especiales, y nos encantará hacerlo en todas las fases de entrevistas.

INSCRÍBETE AHORA ¡ESTAMOS DESEANDO CONOCERTE

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Manager - Gastro
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Job Description
• Identificar y analizar fuentes de datos externas que faciliten un entendimiento de la dinámica del mercado
• Anticipar riesgos & oportunidades y facilitar la toma de decisiones en base a análisis objetivos
• Liderar el desarrollo de las capacidades analíticas a nivel BT / IFT
• Actualizar y optimizar la Metodología Analítica proporcionando herramientas que permitan realizar un diagnóstico preciso así como un seguimiento de los planes de... acción
• Evaluar performance de cada marca a nivel nacional / territorial / cuenta
• Liderar y gestionar la realización de Estudios de Mercado / Competitive Intelligence para cubrir necesidades de información identificadas
• Participación en el proceso de “Insights Generation”
• Como miembro del Brand Team, participar en la elaboración de los Planes Estratégicos & Tácticos de las marcas
• Participar en el proceso de Forecasting / Planificación Estratégica
• Liderar la implementación de la metodología “In-Field Team Excellence” en la marca.

Qualifications
• Capacidad analítica con orientación a negocio
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo
• Capacidad de liderazgo e influencia en entornos matriciales
• Capacidad de innovación
• Licenciatura (Ciencias, Ingenierías, ADE, etc.)
• Conocimientos de Sales Force Effectiveness & Market Research
• Experiencia previa en posiciones de Business Intelligence
• Nivel alto de Inglés
• Zona de trabajo: Madrid
• Residencia: Madrid

Additional Information

AbbVie is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, serving our community and embracing diversity and inclusion. It is AbbVie’s policy to employ qualified persons of the greatest ability without discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected group status

jobs_results.title: Responsable de BI
jobs_results.description:
Únete a nuestro equipo como Responsable de BI.

Con nosotros podrás seguir desarrollándote y aportar con tu experiencia a la planificación, implantación, migraciones, mantenimiento y evolución de los sistemas de gestión y de información corporativos del grupo

Responsabilidades del Responsable de BI:
• Analizar procesos de los diferentes departamentos identificando y/o mejorando los KPI relevantes.
• Dar seguimiento a los proyectos acordados con cada departamento.
• Selección e Implantación de Herramientas de BI.
• Mejora continua de los dashboard definidos
• Garantizar la cultura basada en datos.
• Formación adecuada a los key-user en cada departamento.
• Coordinación con Proveedores externos para la configuración de las Herramientas de Gestión.

Requisitos:
• Grado Universitario en Ingeniería en Sistemas
• Experiencia de entre 3 a 5 años en departamentos de Business Intelligence, habituado a trabajar en la integración de sistemas de BI para los diferentes departamentos de la... empresa, preferiblemente Qlik Sense, valorándose la interacción con sistemas ERP’s como SAP ByDesign.
• Conocimientos en tecnologías ETL’s.
• Nivel intermedio de inglés

¿Te interesa? Aplica con nosotros

jobs_results.title: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE CONSULTANT
jobs_results.description:
Are you the one?

Become part of our Information Technologies department as a member of the Business Intelligence team and develop yourself in a multinational context!

As a BI Consultant your mission will be to provide the business with the necessary tools to be able to analyze information and make decisions through BI technologies, improving and maintaining our current ecosystem.

You will be in continuous contact with key business users to seek improvements and develop the BI infrastructure

If you are passionate about processes and BI, then this might be your chance!

Your Role Highlights – Your Responsibilities
• You will maintain meetings with users to take the analytical needs of the different business areas.
• You will analyze and understand the company's processes in order to design the necessary tools to support decision making.
• You will develop extraction, transformation and loading processes.
• You will build and enhance the company's data warehouse.
• You will develop... reports and dashboards that help to monitor the company's performance.
• You will support users by resolving any doubts they may have about how to use the BI tools.

Become SanLucarian - What’s in for you?
• You’ll find a dynamic and changing work environment
• Feel comfortable leaving your suit behind! We don’t have a dress code
• Experience different cultures - Multinational is what describes us best as we’re a team of 30 nationalities
• Free language courses for all SanLucarians

Requirements:
• Education: Degree in Computer Science, Telecommunication engineering or similar degrees. A Master in Power BI or data analitics is very valued.
• You are fluent in Spanish and you have a good level of English.
• At least 4 years of experience in a similar position in a multinational company.
• Experience in the development of BI projects, preferably in SQL Server, (T-SQL, Integration Services, Analysis Services)
• Advanced knowledge in Excel.
• Knowledge in Power BI (DACS language)
• Knowledge of tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Tableau...
• You are passionate about applications and their development

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Title:

Business Intelligence Developer

Job Description

The Business Intelligence Developer is an experienced professional working with data (analysing, modelling and visualizing). They will use Business Intelligence tools to develop, implement and support both client and internally focused Business Intelligence & Insights dashboards. They will contribute to the creation of design specifications and provide guidance on the feasibility of developing proposed solutions. They will pro-actively monitor production of such Business Intelligence & Insights solutions and resolve issues in a timely manner.

Responsibilities:
• Participate in solution design discussions, contributing recommendations on how Business Intelligence requirements can be met
• Effectively follow solution design documentation and determine how they will approach development of proposed solutions
• With only moderate support, develop Business Intelligence dashboards and reports
• Ensure all development adheres to... the team's development framework
• Implement solutions following the appropriate change and code control processes and tools. Complete all corresponding documentation.
• Monitor production of own and other team members solutions ensuring production issues are quickly identified and analyzed
• With only moderate support, identify and correct production errors related to overall team responsibilities.
• Communicate effectively with Business Intelligence stakeholders in relation to Business Intelligence outages and data governance issues
• Understand potential drivers behind data quality issues and with only moderate support, investigate and/or leverage appropriate resources effectively to resolve even complex issues that occur
• Contribute to the production of documentation that supports end user knowledge of Business Intelligence & Insights solutions delivered

Profile:
• Must have at least a 2 years' experience working on Business Intelligence development or related formal educational experience
• Must have proven track record in writing complex formulas
• Understanding of relational databases and an ability to write basic SQL queries
• Experience with working with stakeholders on Business Intelligence requests would be an advantage
• Sense of professionalism and ability to develop relationships
• Strong attention to detail
• Self-starter, sense of urgency, and works well under pressure
• Ability to prioritize and meet timelines on deliverables
• Proficient in Microsoft Office including strong Excel skills
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
• Preferable to have experience of working in a contact centre environment for at least 2 years

Location:

ESP Barcelona - Malaga Spain Client Site

Language Requirements:

Time Type:

R1490063

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Opportunity

This is an exciting time for BI & Analytics in ESW as we continue to build out a sustainable and scalable data environment that provides us with the ability to leverage the latest tools and technologies available through the cloud (Google & Azure) to facilitate fast, data-driven management decisions, and discover new insights in the ever-growing eCommerce industry. Within the Data team, we have an opportunity for a motivated, curious and talented BI Engineer who is interested in working with a wide range of Google Cloud Platform services and the Looker BI platform.

This role offers the successful candidate several opportunities to upskill with the latest technologies in the market (GCP, Looker, Azure DevOps), the agile framework SAFe, application of CI/CD delivery, security, DevOps, etc., all the while working in a fully cloud-based environment.

Key Responsibilities
• You should be committed to delivering fast and quality and possess a passion for data and the value... it can bring.
• You will work with BI and the wider business to translate business requirements into solutions (Data Modelling + LookML + Looks + Dashboard) to deliver business insights, trends, and analysis visually compellingly through Looker and supporting platforms.
• Ensure the deployment of updates/enhancements to the Looker production environment aligns with our deployment workflow standards and procedures.
• Create and enhance documentation as solutions require e.g. high-level design specifications, business glossary updates, data model architecture updates, etc.
• Work with the Product team to ensure there is a clear understanding of requirements and deliverables as part of any new feature requests.
• Work as a member of the BI scrum team to ensure there is clarity and alignment to current and future work items – providing the necessary input into user stories as required, estimating user stories, and engaging in all scrum-related ceremonies.
• You will work closely with teams across our business to understand their business problems/requirements and proactively design and champion solutions to deliver the required business value.
• Support the maintenance of legacy reporting (SQL Server & SharePoint) and all activities attached to the migration of these reports onto the Looker platform.

Key Experience & Skills
• A degree in a relevant discipline, e.g. Information Systems (Business or Computing).
• Deep knowledge of databases and T-SQL or query-writing skills - SQL Server, MySQL, or similar.
• Knowledge of query optimization and performance tuning.
• Exposure to BI tools, such as Looker, Microsoft (SSIS, SSRS, SharePoint), Tableau, QlikView or Excel BI tools – PowerPivot/Power BI.
• Demonstrable skills in understanding complex business problems and translating those to simple-to-use BI solutions or reports.
• Understanding of what can be improved through better data and analysis.
• An understanding of dimensional data models using methodology such as Kimball would be advantageous.
• Knowledge of eCommerce or Supply Chain would also be an advantage.
• Experience with GIT or other version control systems and exposure to Agile and Scrum methodologies will be beneficial.

Desired Behaviours
• You should be eager to work in a fast-paced eCommerce environment.
• Demonstrate willingness and openness to learning new technologies and practices.
• Excellent personal organisation & work-management skills – ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
• Strong problem-solving skills.
• Ability to apply business acumen to data-driven outputs to deliver value-added insights.
• Ability to present clear and concise outputs articulating how data and analysis relate to Key Performance Indicators.
• High level of dedication to see things through to completion, with high quality.
• Strong level of versatility & willingness to contribute to a company with phenomenal growth.
• Willingness to contribute to conversations and propose ideas.
• Commitment to deliver good service to our internal and external partners.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and a career path adapted to each person's abilities and experience within a company that is growing continuously.
• 2 days a week working from home.
• A flexible schedule and total conciliation between work and family life including reduced timetable during one month in summer.
• Become part of a multi-cultural company where you can contribute with your experience and learn from the experience of others.
• Work with amazing brands.
• Get the opportunity to influence the future of our services and platform.
• Excellent working environment with frequent social activities (hackathons, Spartan races, quarterly whole-team social event).
• Central Madrid office located an 8-minute walk from Atocha train station, with a bus stop and BiciMad station right outside the office.
• Kitchen and dining facilities as well as a fully stocked games room with games consoles etc. - great to disconnect from work for a while and have fun with your colleagues.
• Discounted parking space in the office building if you’re coming by car, bicycle parking for those worried about their carbon footprint.
• Access to private sales by some of the exclusive brands we work with.
• Enrollment in English, French, and Spanish lessons that take place during working hours.
• Mental Health Wellbeing Program.

About us:

ESW is the leading global and domestic direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce company, empowering the world's best-loved brands to create safer, simpler and faster shopping experiences for consumers all around the globe. ESW acquired Scalefast in June 2022, and the combined 1,300 person organization offers brands and retailers a complete portfolio of technology and services that cost-effectively support any stage of company's development.

From compliance, data security, fraud protection, taxes and tariffs to demand generation, checkout, delivery, returns and customer service, our powerful combination of technology and human ingenuity covers the entire shopper journey across 200 markets, with 100% carbon neutral shipping to consumers. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, ESW has global offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, Italy, Japan, Hong Kong and Singapore. ESW is an Asendia Group company, a joint venture between La Poste and Swiss Post

jobs_results.title: Analista con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial
jobs_results.description:
NTT Data somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes y los diferentes sectores en los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad; telecomunicaciones, sector financiero (banca y seguros), industria, utilities, sector público y sanidad.

¿Nuestra misión? Ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría. Todo gracias a la colaboración entre equipos, la calidad humana de nuestra gente y a que no nos conformamos con lo establecido, buscamos siempre la innovación que nos acerca al futuro.

En Valencia seguimos en proceso de crecimiento y buscamos Analistas interesados en participar en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial.

Se requiere:
• Tener la titulación del Grado en Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas o titulaciones relacionadas.
• Especialmente valorable haber cursado... especializaciones en IA, o cursos y másteres especializados en ese sentido.
• Al menos 3-5 años de experiencia trabajando con algoritmos de inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático.
• Experiencia comprobada en programación, preferiblemente en Python.
• Dominio de librerías de IA y ML como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.
• Excelentes habilidades de análisis y resolución de problemas.
• Fuertes habilidades de liderazgo y gestión de proyectos.
• Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente y trabajar en equipo.

Sus funciones se basarán en:
• Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar modelos de inteligencia artificial generativa.
• Asistir en la integración de los algoritmos de IA en procesos y casos de uso empresariales.
• Mantenerse actualizado en las últimas tendencias y tecnologías en inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático.
• Liderar el análisis y preprocesamiento de datos para alimentar los modelos de IA.
• Conocimiento sobre las métricas de rendimiento de modelos y el ciclo de MLOps.
• Experiencia en la implementación de modelos de aprendizaje automático en producción.
• Supervisar pruebas, validaciones y optimización de los modelos generados.
• Gestionar proyectos y coordinar con otros equipos y stakeholders.

NTT Data te ofrece:

- Contrato indefinido

- Retribución salarial acorde con la experiencia aportada

- Plan de Carrera

- Plan de Formación personalizado a nivel profesional y técnico

jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Developer
jobs_results.description:
As a BI developer, will play a critical role in bridging the gap between data sources and end-users, ensuring that the reporting process is efficient, reliable, and aligned with the Supply Chain Digitization strategy and goals. You will design, develop, test, and maintain comprehensive automated reporting tools and workflows that enable stakeholders to access timely and accurate information for decision-making purposes. Producing process documentation to outline mistakes and successes and refine processes going forward.

You will need to ensure the accuracy, stability, and scalability of reports, align reporting with global best practices, and collaborate with stakeholders to validate and align data. You will implement alerts and controls for key metrics to promptly identify deviations and drive risk-reducing actions.

Major Accountabilities:
• Develop and maintain global reporting systems for the Supply Chain Digitization team that provide accurate and timely information for... decision-making purposes. Work with IT and other stakeholders to build out a complete suite of automated reports that drive the Supply Chain Digitization strategy.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting requirements and ensure alignment with business goals. Translate business requirements into actionable user-friendly tools.
• Design and generate reports, dashboards, and visualizations to effectively communicate key performance indicators and trends.
• Ensure data is available and accurate to be used on internal processes.
• Align reporting across all the Supply Chain Digitization systems and dependent systems to effectively monitor implementation success.
• Investigate and propose external data sources that can bring value for supply chain processes.
• Follow the standard reporting timelines with no delays.
• Ensure stability and scalability of reports, tools and automations. Set up automatic alerts to identify errors in the automations and refresh of the reports. Ensure data accuracy and integrity by implementing and enforcing best practices in data management and reporting processes.
• Analyze data to identify insights, trends, and areas for improvement, and present findings to key stakeholders.
• Lead the development and optimization of reporting tools and technologies, staying abreast of industry trends and advancements.
• Train and support end-users on reporting tools and systems, promoting self-service reporting capabilities.
• Work closely with all internal stakeholders to improve user experience.
• Support cross-functional teams on the day-to-day execution of projects and initiatives.
• Create internal documentation about products created.

Experience:
• Experience in a reporting or BI role, with a minimum of 3 years of experience.
• Experience developing ETL processes.
• Relational databases knowledge (SQL) and programming skills (SQL, Python).
• Experience developing visualization tools as an architect/developer in Power BI.
• Experience designing and developing data models that can feed visualization tools.
• Experience developing and streamlining automation processes.
• Experience managing large datasets and optimizing internal database processes.
• Experience translating requirements into actionable business solutions.

Skills and Knowledge:
• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or similar
• Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and data analysis tools (e.g., SQL) and databases management.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
• Strong analytical and technical skills
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
• Experience with working on multi stakeholder projects
• Ability to work autonomously. Ability to learn on the fly.
• Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

Languages:
• Fluent English.
• Spanish would be a plus
